# BRD Draft

Draft a business requirements document (BRD) from workshop notes, interview transcripts, emails and existing documents: objectives, scope, stakeholders, current and future process, numbered SHALL requirements (BR-<area>-<n>) grouped by functional area with priority, rationale, source and fit criterion, business rules, data and reporting needs, non-functional needs, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, a glossary, and numbered open questions with an owner for each. Sources that disagree become open questions, empty sections stay marked "no information yet", and nothing — numbers, dates, owners, rules — is ever invented.
